- Click on the Windows Start button in the bottom-left corner of the taskbar to open the Start menu.
- Click on an empty area of the desktop background in the forest wallpaper.
- Right-click on an empty area of the desktop background in the forest wallpaper to open the context menu.
- Click on "Microsoft Word 文档" (Microsoft Word Document) option in the submenu to create a new Word document on the desktop.
- Type "test" and then press the Enter key twice to create some space in the document.
- Click on the Windows Start button located in the bottom-left corner of the taskbar.
- Select the text of the Chinese article by clicking at the beginning of the text content near the title "朱自清" and dragging down to the bottom of the article to highlight the text for copying.
- Press Ctrl+C to copy the selected text to the clipboard.
- Click on the "test.docx" Word document in the Windows taskbar to switch to it.
- Press Ctrl+V to paste the copied text into the document.
- Select the author's name "朱自清" by clicking at its beginning and dragging to the end of the name text to highlight it for formatting.
- Click on the "Center" alignment button in the mini formatting toolbar above the text to center-align the current paragraph containing the author's name.
- Click on a font size option in the dropdown menu to adjust the size of the title text.
- Click on the "小二" font size option in the dropdown menu to apply this size to the selected title text.
- Select a portion of the title text "朱自清" by clicking and dragging from the right side of the text to adjust the selection area to the left.
- Click on the center alignment button in the mini formatting toolbar above the selected title text.
- Click on the main text paragraph where the cursor is currently positioned to ensure it's selected before applying paragraph formatting.
- Select all the main text by clicking at the beginning of the first paragraph and dragging down to the end of the document to highlight all the content for formatting.
- Right-click on the selected text in the document to bring up the context menu with formatting options.
- Click on the paragraph indentation control in the mini formatting toolbar below the context menu.
- Click on the "宋体" (SimSun) font option in the Recently Used Fonts section of the font dropdown menu to apply this font to the selected text.
- Click on the paragraph indentation button in the mini formatting toolbar to apply first-line indentation to the selected text.
- Click on the "四号" (Size 4) font size option in the font size dropdown menu to apply this size to the selected text.
- Click in the main text document at the position where "水滴在人海里" text appears to place the cursor where an image will be inserted.
- Press Ctrl+A to select all content in the document.
- Right-click on the text near "水滴在人海里" to open the context menu with options for inserting content at this location.
- Click on the "Paragraph" option in the context menu to open paragraph formatting settings.
- Click on the dropdown arrow button next to "(none)" in the Special indentation field to open the indentation type options.
- Click on the "First line" option in the Special indentation dropdown menu to set first-line indentation for paragraphs.
- Click the "OK" button in the Paragraph formatting dialog box to apply the first-line indentation settings.
- Click in the document at the position in the text near "那里呢?" to place the cursor for image insertion.
- Press the Enter key to create a new line in the document, providing space for image insertion.
- Click on the "Insert" tab in the Microsoft Word ribbon to access image insertion options.
- Click on the "Pictures" button in the Insert tab of the ribbon to open the image insertion dialog.
- Click on "This Device..." option in the "Insert Picture From" dropdown menu to browse for images on the computer.
- Double-click on the "保存的图片" (Saved Pictures) folder to open it and view its contents.
- Double-click on the green forest/nature image with filename "5a7ba53362975...8ae1e8.jpg" to select and insert it into the Word document.
- Drag from the bottom-right corner handle of the inserted image diagonally toward the center to resize the image to a smaller size while maintaining its aspect ratio.
- Press Ctrl+S to open the Save dialog box for saving the document.
- Click on the File tab in the upper-left corner of the Microsoft Word window to access file operations.

Use the "Paragraph" function to set a two-character indent for the first line of the text and a line spacing of 1.5 times. Click the "Save" button and save the document locally.

Previous actions:
- Click on the Windows Start button in the bottom-left corner of the screen to open the Start menu.
- Click on the Microsoft Word application icon in the Start menu to launch Word.
- Click on the close button (X) in the top-right corner of the Microsoft Word window.
- Double-click on the "空白文档" (Blank document) template to create a new blank Word document.
- Click in the middle of the empty document area to position the text cursor for typing.
- Type the word "Life" into the document to begin the English paragraph.
- Press the space key and type "is beautiful" to continue forming the English paragraph.
- Select the text "Life is beautiful" by clicking and dragging from after the text to before the text to highlight it for formatting.
- Click on the font dropdown arrow next to "等线 (西文正文)" to open the font selection menu.
- Type "Times New Roman" to search for and select this font from the font dropdown menu.
- Click on "Times New Roman" in the font dropdown list to apply this font to the selected text.
- Drag from the end of "Life is beautiful" text to the beginning of the text to select it.
- Click on the font size dropdown showing "五号" to open the font size selection menu.
- Click on the "12" option in the font size dropdown menu to set the selected text to font size 12.
- Click on the "插入" (Insert) tab in the ribbon menu at the top of the Microsoft Word interface to access picture insertion options.
- Click on the "图片" (Picture) button in the Insert ribbon to open the file browser for selecting an image to insert.
- Click on the "此设备(D)..." (This device) option in the dropdown menu to open the file browser dialog for selecting an image from a local folder.
- Scroll down in the file browser while positioned over the "图片" (Pictures) folder in the left navigation pane to view more content or files that may be available below.
- Click on the "新加卷 (G:)" (New Volume G:) drive in the left navigation pane of the file browser dialog to explore its contents for images to insert.
- Double-click on the AgentNet folder to open it and view its contents.
- Double-click on the "download" folder to open it and explore its contents for image files.

For your convenience, UI elements are labeled with numeric marks.

Use the "Paragraph" function to set a two-character indent for the first line of the text and a line spacing of 1.5 times. Click the "Save" button and save the document locally.

Previous actions:
- Click on the "About" link at the bottom of the Google homepage.
- Click on the Microsoft Word icon in the Start menu to launch the application.
- Click the maximize button in the top-right corner of the Microsoft Word window to expand the window to full screen.
- Double-click on the "空白文档" (Blank Document) template to create a new blank document.
- Click in the middle of the blank document area to position the cursor for text input.
- Type "Life" in the document to begin the English paragraph.
- Press the space key and then type "is beautiful" to continue forming the English paragraph after the word "Life".
- Select the text "Life is beautiful" by clicking near the end of the text and dragging to the beginning of the text.
- Click on the font dropdown arrow next to "等线 (西文正文)" in the font section of the toolbar to open the font selection menu.
- Type "Times New Roman" to search for and filter the font dropdown list to locate the Times New Roman font option.
- Click on the "Times New Roman" option in the font dropdown menu to apply this font to the selected text.
- Select the text "Life is beautiful" by dragging from the end of the text to the beginning. Click and hold near the end of "beautiful" and drag left to the beginning of "Life".
- Click on the font size dropdown arrow next to "五号" to open the font size selection menu.
- Click on the "12" option in the font size dropdown menu to set the selected text to 12-point size.
- Click on the picture insertion option in the "插入" (Insert) tab of the ribbon menu.
- Click on the "图片" (Picture) icon in the Insert tab ribbon menu to open the image insertion dialog.
- Click on "此设备(D)..." (This device...) option to open the file browser dialog for selecting a picture from the local storage.
- Scroll down in the file explorer navigation pane while focusing on the "图片" (Pictures) folder area to view more folder options.
- Click on the "新加卷 (G:)" drive in the left navigation pane of the file explorer dialog to browse its contents for images.
- Double-click on the AgentNet folder to open it and browse its contents for image files.
- Double-click on the "download" folder to open it and continue searching for image files to insert into the document.
- Double-click on the Michael_Jordan_in_2014.jpg file to select and insert it into the document.
- Drag the image from its current position toward the middle-right area of the document by clicking on the image and dragging it downward.
- Click on the "绕行文字" (Text Wrapping) dropdown button in the Picture Format tab of the ribbon to open the text wrapping options menu.
- Click on the text wrapping option in the middle position of the second row in the layout options dialog to apply a contoured text wrapping style to the image.
- Click on the text wrapping option in the first column of the second row of the layout options dialog, which shows a square with lines flowing around both sides, representing text wrapping around the image.
- Click on the "查看更多..." (View more...) link at the bottom of the layout options dialog to access additional layout settings for the image.
- Click on the suit jacket area of the inserted image to select or interact with the image.
- Resize the image by dragging from the bottom-right corner handle of the image upward and to the left to make the image smaller. This will reduce the image size proportionally while maintaining its aspect ratio.
- Click in the empty area of the document to the right of the image to position the cursor for text editing.
- Scroll down in the document by using the mouse wheel while the cursor is positioned in the middle of the document area.
- Type "jordan is the best basketball player." in the document where the cursor is positioned.
- Click at the beginning of the word "jordan" in the text to position the cursor for selecting the text.
- Press the Enter key to create a new line break before the text "Jordan is the best basketball player."
- Select the text "Jordan is the best basketball player." by clicking at the end of the sentence (after the period) and dragging to the left until the beginning of the word "Jordan".
- Right-click on the word "Jordan" in the text to open the context menu with selection and formatting options.
- Click on the "段落(P)..." (Paragraph) option in the context menu to open the paragraph formatting dialog.
- Click on the line spacing dropdown that currently shows "单倍行距" (single spacing) to open the line spacing options menu.
- Click on the "1.5 倍行距" (1.5 line spacing) option in the line spacing dropdown menu to set the line spacing to 1.5.
- Click on the dropdown box next to "特殊(S)" (Special) to open the special indentation options menu.
- Click on the "首行" (First Line) option in the special indentation dropdown menu to select the first line indent formatting option.
- Click the "确定" (OK/Confirm) button at the bottom of the paragraph formatting dialog to apply the paragraph settings.
- Click the "确定" (OK/Confirm) button at the bottom of the paragraph formatting dialog to apply the paragraph settings.
